Something that was pointed out to me a while back that I've taken into consideration ever since - judge the community reaction to clones. Not if the clone itself is awesome-sauce or garbage, but the anticipation towards something. If there's a ton of people clamoring the FT forums for a cheap clone of the ThisorThat, then maybe it's worth looking into why the Authentic ThisorThat is worth what is being asked. Probably because it's an awesome ThisorThat, and isn't going to be pumped out by the dozen (a little more TLC in the manufacturing process is always a good thing) - like I said, I'm staring down the barrel of an Avocado purchase and I'm able to satisfyingly sit back and ...
